name: Philo
notes: Researched from public help.philo.com articles only (no sign-in). Philo is charged automatically to a card, a bank account through Stripe Link, Apple Pay, Cash App or Google Pay; no AutoPay enrollment, paper bill, guest payment or payment plans. Plans: Essential $25 and Bundle+ $33 a month (Free Channels $0 is a free tier, not modeled as a plan); add-ons from $3 to $13 a month are in help. Upgrades apply right away (prorated); downgrades from Bundle+ to Essential apply at the next billing cycle (engine applies immediately; gap). Philo has a no-refund policy; access continues to the end of the billing cycle. Sign-in is passwordless: mobile number or email, then a link or one-time code and Confirm sign-in. The engine always asks for a password (gap: no passwordless/one-time-code sign-in identifier), so identifier 'email' with the label 'Mobile number or email'. Third-party billers (Amazon, Apple, Google, Roku, Samsung, Vizio) may add a surcharge and are canceled with that biller.

guest_pay.note: Philo charges the payment method on your account; there is no bill to pay without signing in.

autopay.note: Your subscription is charged automatically each billing cycle to the payment method on your account.

autopay_cancel.note: To stop future charges, cancel your subscription.

paperless.note: Philo does not mail bills; invoices are in Billing History on your Account page.

payment_arrangement.note: Philo is charged each billing cycle and installment plans are not offered.

cancel_service.note: You keep access until the end of your billing cycle; Philo does not give refunds. If Amazon, Apple, Google, Roku, Samsung or Vizio bills you, cancel with them.

change_plan.note: Upgrading to Bundle+ applies right away with a prorated charge. Moving from Bundle+ to Essential applies at your next billing cycle.

notes: Subscribers billed through Amazon, Apple, Google, Roku, Samsung or Vizio may pay a surcharge; switching to Philo billing avoids it.

help.title: Philo plans and add-ons
paragraphs: Essential is $25 a month for 70+ channels plus more than 100 free ad-supported channels, with recordings saved up to a year. Bundle+ is $33 a month and adds extra ad-supported AMC+ content, HBO Max Basic with Ads and ad-supported discovery+. Free Channels costs nothing and needs no card.
Essential and Bundle+ members can add ALLBLK ($7), ad-free AMC+ ($4), ad-free discovery+ ($8), Hallmark+ ($8.99), HBO Max Standard ($13), Movies & More ($3), MGM+ ($8) or STARZ ($12), each per month.

help.title: Change your plan
paragraphs: On your Account page choose Manage Plan, select a plan and Continue, review your payment info, accept the terms and Submit.

Upgrading from Essential to Bundle+ takes effect right away with a prorated charge for the rest of the month (during a free trial you are charged a full month). Moving from Bundle+ to Essential keeps Bundle+ until your next billing cycle.
steps: Review, accept the terms and Submit.

help.title: Cancel your Philo subscription
paragraphs: Sign in, choose your profile and Account, then Cancel my subscription and Complete cancellation. The Your Philo Subscription section shows the last day of your billing cycle.

You keep your subscription until that day and Free Channels after it. Philo does not give refunds for the current period. Locking your card does not stop charges. If a device store or TV maker bills you, cancel through them.

help.title: How to pay for Philo
paragraphs: On philo.com you can pay with Visa, Mastercard, Discover or American Express credit cards, Visa, Mastercard or American Express debit cards, a bank account through Link, Apple Pay, Cash App or Google Pay.

If you subscribed through Amazon, Apple, Google, Roku, Samsung or Vizio, that company charges you and may add a surcharge. You can switch to billing by Philo on your Account page; the switch applies after your current billing cycle.

help.title: View and print your invoice
paragraphs: On your Account page, scroll to Billing History and choose View invoice next to a charge. The invoice opens as a PDF you can save or print.

extra.intent: Using the Philo help pages, find the monthly price of the Bundle+ plan. Do not change your plan or make a payment.
Using the Philo help pages, find what the STARZ add-on costs per month. Do not add it or make a payment.

solution.text: The STARZ add-on is $12 a month.
